Initial release of Text To Video CapCut AI.

- Instantly convert text prompts or scripts into AI-generated TikTok-ready videos, complete with visuals and background music.
- Supports uploads of TXT, DOCX, MP4, or MOV files up to 200MB.
- Simple setup: anonymous token generation with 100 free credits and session management handled automatically.
- Cloud-based rendering delivers 1080p MP4 output in around 1–2 minutes.
- Includes file upload, project timeline preview, credit checking, status updates, and efficient export workflows.
- Designed for quick, no-edit video creation—ideal for creators who want fast results without manual editing.
